subject: SIG artifact delivery — follow-up on access exceptions and redaction plan

From: Sabrina Holt <sabrina.holt@clearwave.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@clearwave.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up & artifact access request

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the SIG submission last week — the intake looks good. Our security team has a handful of evidence items they'd like to validate for the encryption and access-control questions. Can you provide:

- The current access control runbook (preferably PDF) that shows role mappings and approval flows
- A screenshot of the KMS key rotation history for the last 12 months
- A short one-paragraph summary of your one-time access process for third-party reviewers (how long links remain valid, who approves, etc.)
- If available, a recording or log excerpt for the admin session where the encryption policy was last updated (we understand recordings may need redaction — we can accept a redacted export)

We usually need these items to close the SIG within 7 business days. Please let me know if any of these are sensitive and require a limited-access link or redaction.

Best,
Sabrina Holt
Senior Security Reviewer
ClearWave Health
[Attachment: requested_evidence_list.pdf]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Sabrina Holt <sabrina.holt@clearwave.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up & artifact access request

Hi Sabrina — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide these. Quick notes up front:

- Access control runbook: prepared and can share as a PDF. We will redact personal contact info before sharing.
- KMS rotation history: we can provide a screenshot of the KMS console showing key rotation events; will mark timestamps and key IDs.
- One-time access process: we use a short-lived shared Drive link (default 7 days) plus audit logging; manual approval by our Security Ops owner is required for any request.
- Session recordings: we can provide a redacted clip and session logs; full recordings are restricted and require an exception.

I'll drop the artifacts to a shared Drive folder and share a manifest link. If you need a different expiry or a service account access, let us know.

Deliverables planned (ETA Wed EOD PT):
- SIG_Responses_v1.xlsx (answers + internal references)
- access_control_runbook.pdf (redacted)
- kms_rotation_summary.png (screenshot)
- session-recording-access-manifest.txt (instructions + access policy)

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: planned_delivery_manifest.txt]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up & artifact access request

Looping in a couple of specifics for the artifacts:

Mateo — for the access_control_runbook.pdf please include:
- Role names and brief bullet descriptions (no usernames)
- The approval flow diagram (PDF page) — we can blur internal IDs if needed
- A note on org unit mapping to access groups

Karthik — can you confirm the last KMS rotation dates and whether rotation is automated? If it's automated, include the cron schedule and the team owning alerts. If manual, include the ticket/owner from the last rotation.

Also, for the session recording: we should not share raw recordings. Instead provide:
- Redacted 3-minute clip showing the config change (blur names) OR
- Admin session log export (timestamped commands + actor)

I can own the redaction pass if you share a temporary edit link.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up & artifact access request

Grace / Mateo — confirmed: KMS rotation is automated via our internal KeyOps pipeline. Summary:

- Rotation cadence: 90 days (automated)
- Pipeline: keyops-rotate (triggered and audited in CloudAudit)
- Last rotation: 2026-09-16 03:07:12 UTC (ticket #KOPS-3479)
- Alerts: rotation failures route to security-ops pager and KeyOps slack channel

I'll prepare a screenshot of the rotation events and attach the ticket reference. Also exporting the admin session logs for the config change as a sanitized CSV (no PII).

Attachments to include in the Drive folder: kms_rotation_summary.png, keyops_ticket_KOPS-3479.pdf, admin_session_log_20260916.csv

—Karthik

Sabrina — delivering the items we discussed. Notes and access instructions below.

Drive folder (shared, view-only, expires 2026-12-09):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleSharedFolder

- One-time Drive links default to 7 days and are logged; if you require a shorter expiry, reply with the desired window and we will adjust.

If you confirm receipt, we'll mark the SIG items as "evidence provided" in our tracker. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if you'd like us to walk through any screenshots.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Technical Account Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
